headline: Why Are Accenture (ACN) Shares Soaring Today
summary: Shares of global professional services company Accenture (NYSE:ACN) jumped 5.9% in the afternoon session after the company announced a $2 billion share repurchase program and a new quarterly dividend, supported by strong recent earnings and positive business developments. The capital return plan acted as a catalyst for the stock, which had already seen a rebound as investors reassessed the company's position.
